vetSays.line: 🛡️ Kofi, Javier, Danylo and Meruert met them at the door — 4 put down. Kofi, Javier, Meruert are hurt.
🛡️ Kofi, Javier, Meruert and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down. Kofi, Javier, Meruert, Nino are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kofi, Danylo and Nino met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kofi, Danylo, Nino are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kofi just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kofi, Danylo, Olivia, Nino and Boris met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kofi, Danylo, Olivia, Nino, Boris are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Javier just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Mia and Aria met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Mia, Aria are hurt.

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk
a soft green glow under the water
